decision_policy: Pair thresholds emit sets; never force one-to-one or a fixed number of targets. Every full-universe and candidate-restricted decision is preserved.
fitting_scope: Transductive unlabeled fitting on the observed left/right records in this split. No identity labels, family metadata, source identifiers or outcome scores are loaded. Development and test fits are separate.

lexical.candidate_union: Union top 10 each by title word cosine, title character cosine and explicit combined score; include any shared model identifier; order union by combined score then opaque ID; retain first 20.
lexical.description: TF-IDF word 1-2 grams; all observed description text

numerical_revision_boundary: v6 was approved after v5 Amazon test failed the 100-iteration convergence limit (delta 0.000242675), before any test identity outcomes. Only cap increased to 500; same tolerance/algorithm. Broad prior sensitivity added for unknown overlap identifiability, with the primary unchanged; no selection by outcomes.
prior_attribution_policy: Recordwise extraction must reuse conventional split numeric prior and sensitivity grid exactly; agreement counts from extracted data never set its prior.

prior.bounds: Exclude probability outside (0,1); no one-to-one cap imposed on a many-target relation. These assumptions are not measured recall.

broad_sensitivity.boundary: Descriptive prior-only posterior sensitivity at fixed learned likelihoods, not refits, chosen priors, label estimates or cardinality caps.

prior.rule: exact nonmissing brand and primary model OR exact nonempty normalized title
prior.strict_anchor_recall: unknown; declared recall values are assumptions, not estimates
prior.zero_rule_fallback: 1/max(left_count,right_count), an explicitly assumed sparse-overlap prior, with multipliers0.5/1/2.

splink.prior_boundary: EM may update each blocked sample's match fraction; populate-global-prior is false, so the separately specified population prior stays unchanged.
splink.term_frequency_adjustment: exact brand agreement only; fit EM without TF then apply at prediction

stage_boundary: Predictions saved before evaluation. This runner has no scoring command and does not load truth.json, metadata.json or source-map.json.
unestimated_level_policy: Baseline-v6 preserves v5 probability regularization, with prospective iteration cap 500. Add fixed 1e-6 mass per nonnull level then normalize at initialization, random-u, and each EM M-step. Session/final aggregation only normalizes already positive masses. Unobserved levels use zero raw mass, including numeric u with no sampling estimate. All-zero u becomes uniform; all-zero m copies fixed u. Restore exact normalized random-u after every aggregation. Save raw/default values and flags. Require every nonempty block to converge; failure emits failed_fit without ordinary decisions. No truth-guided retries.
